label: defeated opponent
definition: X defeated opposing competitor Y in at least one competitive contest, including an electoral contest; direction is winner to defeated opponent.
scope_notes: Preserves the prior defeated-opponent scope. Explicit beat, defeat, victory over, trounce or completed elimination qualifies. Playing, facing, losing, standings, trading or political criticism alone do not. Both a win and a loss across historical games can be true; mixed assignments remain flagged.

facts.reason: Baltimore Orioles defeat and beat New York Yankees and have a victory over them; meeting context is different.
Mets explicitly defeat Cubs; losing-to and playoff/game context do not support the same outcome.
Mr. Bush explicitly defeats and beats Al Gore; opponent, loss, advantage and vote-comparison rows are mixed.
Mariners explicitly beat Yankees; meeting, trading and other contextual paths are not victory evidence.
Atlanta Braves defeat and beat New York Mets and have a victory over them.
